stories.title: Police warn drivers to check pay-at-pump card readers for fraud devices
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned drivers to check pay-at-pump card readers at petrol stations after becoming aware of a fraud method that uses hidden devices to steal bank card details. stories.title: police HGV cab catches drivers on their phones on the A55
stories.summary: North Wales Police stopped more than 30 vehicles on the A55, A483 and A494 earlier this month as part of Operation Tramline. stories.title: Senedd: Reform MS accuses health minister of lying during debate over health visitors pay
stories.summary: A Reform Senedd Member has accused the health minister of lying during a debate on the health visitor pay dispute. James Evans, who is shadow minister for health and prevention, hit out at Mabon ap Gwynfor on Wednesday 16 September.
